song.title: Come Sit Here With Me
song.description: Still building despite everything. Still a little hope. A personal song about wanting someone close and making room for them. MusicSubject × Call Me Daddy.

update.title: Come Sit Here With Me
update.summary: Still building despite everything. Still a little hope. A personal song about wanting someone close and making room for them. MusicSubject × Call Me Daddy.
update.cardTag: Still building. Making room for you.
update.cardSummary: I've made so many things alone. I'd like to make some room for you.

lyrics.text:
[Verse 1]
Another page
Another song
Look up again
The evening's gone
There's something here I want to show
Someone I haven't met, I suppose
I made a joke
I' made a beat
There's always something left in me
But some nights I leave it all for someone asking, "Can I call?"
[Verse 2]
I'm still building despite everything
Still a little hope
Still something to sing
But I want someone close with nowhere else to be
You don't have to know where this goes, come sit here with me
I could tell you what I'm making, probably talk about it all night
Then ask what you've been thinking, watch your face come alive
We could put our phones down, let the unfinished things stay
I'd like to hear about your morning, even if nothing happened that day
[Verse 3]
I'm still building despite everything, still got a little hope
Still got something to sing, but I want someone close
With nowhere else to be, you don't have to know
Where this goes, come sit here with me
Maybe I'll lose my place
Maybe you'll laugh and I will too
I've made so many things alone
I'd like to make some room for you
[Verse 4]
I'm still building
And there's more I want to do
Tonight I want someone close
I want to hear them singing too
lyrics.snippet: I'd like to make some room for you
